title: Eganville Curling Club

services.name: Escape Room
services.desc: The Eganville Escape Room is located in the basement of the Eganville Curling Club. The proceeds of the escape room help to fund the curling club. Over the years, revenue from the escape room has contributed to purchasing new stones for the club, pay for infrastructure work in the clubhouse and help to minimize registration fees for members. Stay tuned for “Reactor Meltdown” which is slated to open in June
